caps: HIT/SHIT 17% vs level-63 raid bosses (Forever removes the guaranteed 1% miss); about 4% vs level-equal mobs. Suppression 5/5 gives 5% per wow.gg (so ~12% from gear). Past the cap HIT is worth ~0.
AFFLICTION.notes: Icy Veins and wow.gg: Hit > Spell Power > Crit > Haste > Int. Warcraft Tavern lists Spell Power > Crit > Hit (no cap math). Biggest Forever change: DoTs can crit, and Pandemic/Soul Siphon/Improved Drains build on it, so CRIT is a real Affliction stat for the first time (in classic it was near 0). HASTE is weaker for Affliction because it does not speed DoT ticks or Wrack. Life Tap now scales with Spirit (1 mana per Spirit, 1.2 with Improved Life Tap), so SPI is higher than in classic. STA kept moderate for Life Tap/drain tanking. CRIT=SCRIT, HIT=SHIT (unified in Forever). INT->crit uses classic-era ~60.6 INT per 1% (gap fill). Per-1% weights exceed SP per point by design.
